_comment: Runtime state, written by the dashboard and read by the poller at the top of every tick. config.json is gitignored — this file documents its shape. You do not need to create it: it is written the first time you change something in the dashboard, and everything below falls back to the POLL_* values in .env until then.
_mode: off = poll nothing, spend nothing. watch = poll and list every mention in the inbox, dispatch nothing (you press Start). auto = poll, triage, dispatch the oldest actionable one.
_enabled: Derived from mode (mode !== 'off'). Kept in lockstep because run-once.sh's cheapest gate is a grep for it.
_toggles: Passed through to the pipeline. createLinearIssue: post the one-line @Linear command in the thread and build from the returned issue. codexReplies: after the PR opens, request a Codex review, poll until it lands, run /resolve. saveToMemory: let the run bank lessons via /addmem. reply: post the verdict back in the Slack thread.
_poller: Cadence, the local 24h window ('' disables it), the days to poll on (1=Mon..7=Sun), and the triage model. Changing intervalSec also needs the launchd job reloaded — launchd owns StartInterval, and the Schedule panel's button re-stamps the plist.
_followup: The defaults a new chat's job options start from. A chat overrides any of them from its composer, and its picks live on the run rather than here. An empty workdir falls back to TARGET_REPO in .env.
